stock_onhand_intro: By location and lot, valued at average cost. Held is promised to accepted proformas and approved requisitions; free is what can still be sold or issued.
stock_docs_intro: Receipts, issues, transfers and adjustments. Stock changes only when a document is posted.
stock_cross_branch_hint: Another branch: the stock goes into transit when posted, and arrives when that branch receives it.
stock_currency_hint: Bought in dollars, euros…? Its code, e.g. USD. Empty: birr.
stock_customer_hint: Only for customers worth keeping track of. A walk-in sale needs none.
stock_issued_to_placeholder_customers: Department or person, if not a listed customer
stock_reference_placeholder_receipt: Supplier invoice or delivery note no.
stock_line_unit_cost_birr: Unit cost in birr (per unit above)
stock_landed_total: {amount} (freight, duty… — added to what the stock cost)
stock_post_confirm_body: Stock changes now, and the document gets its number. A posted document cannot be edited; a mistake is corrected with another document.
stock_credit_takes_to: Unless paid, this sale takes it to
stock_credit_cash_only: Cash only: record the payment below before posting.
stock_credit_over: — this sale goes over it. Record a payment first, or have someone allowed to exceed limits post it.
stock_approval_posted_when: It is posted when someone with the right to approve does so on the
stock_change_and_post_again: Change it and post again, or cancel it.
stock_transit_sent_to: Sent to {to}. It is in transit until {to} says what arrived; anything that did not is written off as lost in transit.
stock_transit_received_body: Sent and received quantities. Differences were written off as lost in transit.
stock_fiscal_no_device: No fiscal device is set up for this branch (Admin panel → Fiscal devices).
stock_lines_fefo_hint: Leave "From lot" empty to take the lot that expires first. Expired, quarantined and recalled lots are never issued.
stock_lines_fefo_hint_transfer: Leave "From lot" empty to take the lot that expires first. Expired, quarantined and recalled lots are never issued, except into a quarantine location.
stock_return_hint_sale: Everything still returnable on the sale, back into the lot it left from. Lower each line to what the customer brought back; 0 drops it.
stock_return_hint_purchase: Everything still returnable on the delivery, from the lot it came in as — expired and quarantined stock included. Lower each line to what is going back; 0 drops it.
stock_landed_hint: Freight, insurance, customs duty, the clearing agent… in birr. When the receipt is posted they are shared over its lines and added to what the stock cost. They are not owed to the supplier of the goods.
stock_what_moved_hint: The ledger rows this document wrote, in base units.
stock_err_return_lines: A return lists what the original moved. Change quantities on the return sheet.
stock_err_landed_receipts_only: Landed costs belong on goods receipts.
stock_err_doc_frozen: This document is {status} and can no longer change.
stock_dispatched_as: Dispatched as {number}: in transit until the other branch receives it
stock_sent_for_approval: Sent for approval: {reason}. It posts when someone approves it.
stock_return_drafted: Return drafted with everything returnable — lower it to what is coming back
stock_fiscal_ring_it_up: Ring it up on the device, then enter its FS No.
stock_fiscal_enter_fs: Enter the FS No. as printed.
stock_received_lost: Received. Lost in transit: {lost} — written off.
stock_only_draft_cancel: Only a draft can be cancelled.
stock_payment_hint: The money that went with this document, with its screenshots and receipts.
stock_pay_hint_withholding: {rate}% withholding on {net} is {amount}, which leaves {cash} in cash.
stock_pay_hint_change: Change it if the payment differs.
stock_link_hint: For a payment already recorded — one transfer that paid for several deliveries, say.
stock_doc_has_payment: This document already has a payment.
stock_choose_transaction_list: Choose a transaction from the list.
stock_payment_unlinked: Payment unlinked; the transaction is still recorded.
stock_currency_print: {currency} at {rate} birr — amounts below are in birr
stock_err_start_return: Start a return from the sale or receipt being returned.
stock_err_location_list: Choose a location from the list.
stock_err_supplier_or_new: Choose the supplier, or add a new one.
stock_err_supplier_list: Choose a supplier from the list.
stock_err_customer_list: Choose a customer from the list.
stock_err_two_locations: A transfer needs two different locations.
stock_err_transit_only: Stock in transit moves only by being received.
stock_err_your_branch: Choose a location in your branch.
stock_err_rate: Enter the rate: birr per one {currency}.
stock_err_item_list: Choose an item from the list.
stock_err_not_stocked_receive: {item} is not stocked, so it cannot be received.
stock_err_not_stocked_move: {item} is not stocked, so it cannot be moved.
stock_err_order_line_item: This line delivers an order line; its item cannot change.
stock_err_no_conversion_unit: {item} has no conversion for this unit. Add it on the item's page first.
stock_err_lot_not_item: That lot is not of this item.
stock_err_add_line: Add at least one line before posting.
stock_err_choose_received: Choose where the goods are received.
stock_err_choose_supplier_delivery: Choose the supplier this delivery came from.
stock_err_supplier_gone: The supplier on this receipt no longer exists.
stock_err_choose_location_at: Choose the location the stock is at.
stock_err_choose_returned_go: Choose where the returned goods go.
stock_err_choose_goods_leave: Choose where the goods leave from.
stock_err_return_names_supplier: A return to supplier names the supplier.
stock_err_both_locations: Choose both locations for a transfer.
stock_reason_worth: it is worth {value} at cost, over the {limit} limit
stock_err_item_gone: This line names an item that no longer exists.
stock_err_no_conversion_line: {item} has no conversion for the unit on this line. Add it on the item first.
stock_err_qty_positive: The quantity for {item} must be positive.
stock_err_serial_count: {item} is tracked by serial number: enter exactly {count} serial number(s).
stock_err_not_serial: {item} is not tracked by serial number.
stock_err_weight: Give {item} a weight on its page, or share the {cost} by value.
stock_err_nothing_to_share: There is nothing to share the {cost} over. Give the lines costs.
stock_err_kit_no_components: {kit} has no components. Add them on its page.
stock_err_component_gone: A component of {kit} no longer exists.
stock_err_component_serial: {component} is tracked by serial number and cannot be part of {kit}.
stock_err_component_unit: {component} has no conversion for its unit in {kit}.
stock_err_kit_return_sale: A returned {kit} must come from the sale it was on.
stock_err_kit_sale_missing: The sale of {kit} being returned was not found.
stock_err_lot_expired_receive: Lot {lot} of {item} expired on {date} and cannot be received.
stock_warn_shelf_life: Lot {lot} of {item} has {days} day(s) of shelf life left; its category wants at least {min}.
stock_err_no_main_supplier: {item} has no main supplier. Set one on the item first.
stock_err_held: Only {free} {unit} of {item} is free at {location}: {held} {unit} is held for accepted proformas or approved requisitions.
stock_err_serial_not_here: Serial {serial} of {item} is not in stock at {location}.
stock_err_serial_lot: Serial {serial} belongs to lot {lot}, which is {status}.
stock_err_short: Only {available} {unit} of {item} can be taken from {location}; the line needs {needed} {unit}.
stock_err_short_lot: Only {available} {unit} of {item} in that lot can be taken from {location}; the line needs {needed} {unit}.
stock_err_short_unusable: Expired, quarantined and recalled lots are not counted.
stock_err_lot_expiry_mismatch: Lot {lot} of {item} is already recorded as expiring {existing}, not {given}. Check the pack.
stock_err_serial_in_stock: Serial {serial} of {item} is already in stock.
stock_err_already_received: This transfer has already been received.
stock_err_arrive_before_sent: It cannot arrive before it was sent.
stock_err_serial_not_sent: Serial {serial} of {item} was not sent on this transfer.
stock_err_more_arrived: More of {item} arrived than was sent ({sent}). Record the extra as an adjustment.
stock_err_count_open: Count #{id} of this location is still open. Finish or cancel it first.
stock_err_counted_negative: Counted quantities must be zero or more.
stock_err_choose_stock_item: Choose a stock item from the list.
stock_err_counted_by_serial: {item} is counted by serial number, not here.
stock_err_choose_lot_found: Choose which lot of {item} was found.
stock_err_already_on_count: {item} is already on this count; enter the quantity on its line.
stock_err_uncounted_one: 1 line has not been counted yet. Enter 0 for anything not on the shelf.
stock_err_uncounted_many: {count} lines have not been counted yet. Enter 0 for anything not on the shelf.
stock_reason_count_worth: its differences come to {value} at cost, over the {limit} limit
stock_err_no_stock_left: None of those lots has stock left there any more.
stock_err_expiry_serial: {item} is tracked by serial number; draft its document by hand so the right units are named.
stock_err_no_quarantine: There is no quarantine location. Add one (kind: Quarantine) under Admin panel → Locations first.
stock_note_moved_out: Expired or expiring stock moved out of sale.
stock_err_already_quarantine: Those lots are already in quarantine.
stock_digest_subject_expired_one: 1 expired lot still in stock at {org}
stock_digest_subject_expired_many: {count} expired lots still in stock at {org}
stock_digest_expired_one: 1 lot has expired and is still on the shelves ({value} at cost). Move it to quarantine or write it off.
stock_digest_expired_many: {count} lots have expired and are still on the shelves ({value} at cost). Move them to quarantine or write them off.
stock_digest_showing: Showing 40 of {count}; the page has them all.
stock_err_main_supplier: Choose the main supplier. Use “New supplier” above the list if it is not there yet.
stock_err_item_moved: Stock of this item has already moved, so its base unit and its lot, expiry and serial tracking can no longer change. Create a new item instead.
stock_err_already_base: That is the base unit already; add the pack sizes here.
stock_err_unit_exists: This item already has that unit.
stock_err_barcode_taken: This barcode is already on an item.
stock_err_variant_self: An item cannot be a variant of itself.
stock_err_parent_is_variant: {item} is itself a variant. Choose the item it is a variant of.
stock_err_has_variants: This item has variants of its own, so it cannot be one.
stock_err_variant_label: Say what tells this variant apart, e.g. Red / XL.
stock_err_mark_kit: Mark this item as a kit or recipe first.
stock_err_component_is_kit: {item} is a kit; add its components instead.
stock_err_component_serial_kit: {item} is tracked by serial number, so it cannot be part of a kit.
stock_err_component_no_unit: {item} has no such unit. Add it on its page first.
stock_err_variant_of_variant: This is a variant; add variants to the item it belongs to.
stock_err_sku_taken: Another item already has this code.
stock_v_base_unit: Choose the unit stock is counted in
stock_v_factor: How many base units is one of these?
stock_v_variant_label: Say what tells it apart, e.g. Red / XL
stock_counts_intro: Count a location, and post the differences as one adjustment. Serial-tracked items are checked by serial number instead.
stock_blind_hint: Hide the expected quantities from the counters
stock_count_opened: Count #{id} opened — enter what is on the shelf
stock_post_count_one: 1 difference (net {net}) will be posted as one stock adjustment.
stock_post_count_many: {count} differences (net {net}) will be posted as one stock adjustment.
stock_post_count_none: Every line matches; nothing will be adjusted.
stock_save_counts_first: Save any counts you typed first.
stock_moved_since_one: 1 movement of these items happened at this location after the count was opened. Differences are measured against the snapshot, so make sure what moved was counted the same way — or cancel and start a fresh count.
stock_moved_since_many: {count} movements of these items happened at this location after the count was opened. Differences are measured against the snapshot, so make sure what moved was counted the same way — or cancel and start a fresh count.
stock_find_placeholder: Find an item, code or lot…
stock_found_not_listed: Found something not on the list
stock_count_posted_none: Count posted: the shelf matched the system, nothing to adjust
stock_count_sent_for_approval: Sent for approval: {reason}. It is posted once someone else approves it.
stock_count_cancelled: Count cancelled; stock was not changed
stock_blind_instruction: Blind count: write what you find, not what you expect.
stock_found_not_on_sheet: Items found that are not on this sheet: write them below with their lot and quantity.
stock_expiry_intro: Lots that have expired or will within their category's warning period, where they are, and what they are worth at cost. Expired stock is never sold or issued; move it to quarantine or write it off.
stock_expiry_nothing: Nothing here. Lots appear on this page once they come within their category's expiry warning period.
stock_ticked_summary: {count} ticked · {value} at cost. The whole quantity at each place is drafted.
stock_drafts_transfer_one: 1 draft transfer created — check and post it
stock_drafts_transfer_many: {count} draft transfers created — check and post them
stock_drafts_writeoff_one: 1 draft write-off created — check and post it
stock_drafts_writeoff_many: {count} draft write-offs created — check and post them
stock_email_failed: The email could not be sent. Check the mail settings.
stock_transfers_intro: Stock sent between branches and not yet received. The receiving branch opens the transfer and records what arrived; anything missing is written off as lost in transit.
stock_arrived_short_hint: Transfers received in the last {days} days where something did not arrive.
stock_lot_note_placeholder: Why, e.g. EFDA recall notice no.
stock_lots_intro: Soonest expiry first. Quarantined and recalled lots, and expired ones, are never issued — move them to a quarantine location or write them off with an adjustment.
stock_f_weight: Weight per base unit, kg (optional; shares freight by weight)
stock_f_is_kit: Kit or recipe — sold as one, made of components (never counted itself)
stock_f_track_expiry: Track expiry dates (FEFO; expired lots are blocked)
stock_items_intro: Everything you stock, sell, buy, use or rent out. The ticks decide how it is tracked: medicine and food usually track lots and expiry; equipment tracks serial numbers.
stock_give_barcodes: Give barcodes to {count} item(s) without one
stock_supplier_added_pick: {name} added — pick it as the main supplier.
stock_barcodes_all_have: Every item already has a barcode.
stock_barcodes_clashes: {count} could not be: its in-store code is already typed onto another item.
stock_pack_units_hint: Other units this item is bought, sold or counted in, and how many {base} each one is.
stock_components_hint: What one {unit} of this kit or recipe is made of. Selling it takes these off the shelf it is sold from.
stock_held_hint: Promised and not yet taken: other sales and issues cannot use it.
stock_bin_card_hint: Every movement, newest first, with the balance after it.
stock_err_max_number: The maximum is a number, or empty.
stock_err_max_below_min: The maximum cannot be below the minimum.
stock_no_variants: No variants. Add one for each size, colour or strength that is stocked and priced separately.
stock_variant_copies: It copies this item's unit, category, supplier, tracking, VAT and pack units. Its stock is counted separately.
stock_variant_price: Sale price before VAT (empty: same as this item)
stock_no_levels: No levels per location. The reorder screen uses the item's reorder level for the whole business, and its rate of use.
stock_labels_intro: Shelf labels show the name, the price the customer pays and the barcode. Item labels are small, for sticking on the goods. Items with no barcode print their SKU as a Code 128 barcode, which a scanner reads too.
stock_labels_give_after: on the items page first, so they print scannable EAN-13 codes.
stock_choose_items_hint: Search, then give each item the number of labels it needs.
stock_label_delivery_hint: One label for every unit a posted receipt brought in.
stock_labels_sheet_hint: {count} label(s) on A4 label sheets. Print at 100% scale, with no margins added by the browser.
stock_labels_sheet_hint_for: {count} label(s) for {source} on A4 label sheets. Print at 100% scale, with no margins added by the browser.
stock_labels_truncated: At most 2,000 labels print at once.
